rows.Origin:
Bred by W. Kordes & Sons (Germany, 2007).
Introduced in Canada by Palatine Fruit & Roses as 'Penguin Freelander'.
rows.Bloom: Creamy white with a hint of yellow. Large, double (17-25 petals) bloom form. Blooms in flushes throughout the season.
rows.Growing: USDA zone 5b through 9b. Can be used for cut flower or garden.

colour: Creamy white with a hint of yellow.
